decisions.reason: Having survived the initial launch period and fitting the firm's core bread-making capabilities, it likely performs near aspiration and does not justify reallocating resources.
As a sweet pastry close to the established assortment, it uses existing recipes and skills efficiently and is likely satisfactory enough to retain.
This newer bread faces internal comparison with other loaves, but its close fit with the bakery's core production still makes continued offering more likely than withdrawal.
Because the firm presented it as a flagship seasonal product, management is likely to grant it slack and continue supporting it unless performance is clearly disappointing.
With the poppy seed Christmas stollen positioned as the focal direction, this second stollen is the most likely to underperform relative to aspiration and be cut to free seasonal capacity.
